verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents a dedicated desktop app. Its support page says all vault items are available offline and can be organized into vaults there (docs-9, docs-16), and Pass generates TOTP codes for saved logins (docs-5). The official CLI also gives vault and item access from a computer (docs-2, docs-15). Community comments saying there is no desktop app (comm-2, comm-14) come from early launch-era threads and do not report the documented app failing, so they lower confidence rather than create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that TOTP codes are shown in the desktop app, detail on desktop feature parity or first-class quality, and independent hands-on corroboration of the desktop app.
